paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Strixhaven is a Magic: The Gathering Arena -exclusive card set in the Alchemy series that was released on May 19, 2026.

Alchemy: Strixhaven is a digital-only release adjacent to the release of Secrets of Strixhaven . There are 30 new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (10 uncommons, 15 rares, 5 mythic rares) . The set takes place on Arcavios .

The digital-only mechanics Conjure , Intensity , Perpetually , Seek and Spellbook are reused. The set introduces the keyword Covercast ( Whenever you cast another instant or sorcery spell, if five or more mana was spent to cast it, this card intensifies . ). Though earlier cards specified that they intensified by 1, that number was omitted starting with this set. From the Secrets of Strixhaven set, Opus , Infusion , Increment , Prepare and Repartee are reused. Landfall , Escape , Learn , Replicate , Storm , Suspend and Unearth make cameo appearances.
Soovril, Patient Antiquarian makes use of time counters .

The two other preparation cards feature new spells: Corvid Squall (Galathul Galecaller) and Ranger's Merit (Ursine Guide)
